page.layout: One page, title page. Centred title lines, then the printer's ornament (an engraving of two putti with a wreath), then the imprint at the foot.

main_text.l: Linguæ Sanctæ ac Philosoph. Pract. Professore

l.i: Ad diem Augusti loco horisq; solitis.

page.notes: Engraved ornament between the title and the imprint: two winged putti holding a laurel wreath; no text in it. "horisq;" is my reading of a superscript abbreviation over the q, so it is uncertain. Handwritten marks (a "4" at top right, a "2. 4" at bottom right, and strokes across the title) and the library shelf mark "A-3 937 761" with a library stamp are not printed text and are left out. The pale ghosted print showing through from the verso (the dedicatory text of the following leaf) is show-through and is left out.
